deficiencies.description: The rewrite converts the lecturer's visual pointing gestures into a specific spatial description ('lies next to') that is not stated in the source text.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: You can see that the tumor is here. This is the outer surface of the uterus.

considerations.reason: The text uses 'circumspect', which is an obvious slip of the tongue or transcription error for the standard pathological description 'circumscribed'. Using 'circumscribed' correctly represents the medical concept.
